pages.title: Looking For Aliens
pages.creator: Plug in Digital
pages.description: Explore Earth through alien eyes in Looking For Aliens. Take your time searching each illustrated scene and spot the hidden objects that reveal what the visitors make of our world.

pages.title: Yarn Art Loop
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Send bobbins along the conveyor in Yarn Art Loop. Each one picks up yarn of its own color until it's full. Plan which bobbin goes next.

pages.title: Mob Rush
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Guide an army through multiplication gates in Mob Rush. Build up the unit count, steer around obstacles, and bring enough soldiers to take the opposing territory.

pages.title: Cut the Grass 3D
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Mow overgrown lawns in Cut the Grass 3D. Follow a route that reaches the patches you've missed and unlock more powerful blades as you work through the gardens.

pages.title: Sneaky Friends
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Hide around a school in Sneaky Friends. Find a place to stay out of sight, then look for chances to rescue your teammates and pick up coins.

pages.title: 2248 Blast
pages.creator: Albayoo
pages.description: Swipe through numbers to build chains in 2248 Blast. Look for connections that create a larger value and use the space left by a merge to start another chain.

pages.title: Tricky Life
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Tap and move objects to uncover odd solutions in Tricky Life. Check what reacts in each scene and experiment when the obvious answer doesn't solve the puzzle.

pages.title: Color Dash
pages.creator: TapZap Studio
pages.description: Fly a rocket through matching gates in Color Dash. React when its color changes, steer away from the wrong colors, and use shield or nitro pickups when they help.

pages.title: Geometry Dash Jump
pages.creator: Caner
pages.description: Jump and fly through neon hazards in Geometry Dash Jump. Follow the rhythm as the route changes and time the next move before the obstacle reaches you.

pages.title: Moto X3M Dead Ahead
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Ride a motorcycle with a partner in Moto X3M Dead Ahead. Handle the track's jumps and obstacles while using the shooting mechanics when enemies get in the way.

pages.title: Broken City Combat
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Move through a ruined city in Broken City Combat. Take out armed enemies and look for survivors to rescue while you work your way through the urban fighting.

pages.title: Police Chase Drifter
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Drift away from the police in Police Chase Drifter. Pick up money bags as you head for the finish, then use the proceeds to buy other cars.

pages.title: Witch & Fairy BFF
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Dress two very different friends in Witch & Fairy BFF. Try pink pieces for the fairy and Gothic looks for the witch, then see how the outfits look together.

pages.title: Cute Sheep SkyBlock
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Get two sheep to the portal in Cute Sheep SkyBlock. Jump between floating islands, watch for falling hazards, and work together to get away from the farmers.

pages.title: Ninja: Bamboo Assassin
pages.creator: Endless Games
pages.description: Cut through bamboo in Ninja: Bamboo Assassin to approach enemies quietly. Pick a route that keeps you out of sight and decide when you are close enough to strike.

pages.title: Beach Soccer
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Aim for the goal in Beach Soccer and collect starfish with your shots. Check where crabs and sandcastles sit before choosing an angle that gets past them.

pages.title: Barbiecore Aesthetics
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Create doll-inspired outfits in Barbiecore Aesthetics. Try pastels, retro prints, and fluffy textures, then choose accessories to finish each combination.

pages.title: Stickman Team Detroit
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Choose one of three stick figures in Stickman Team Detroit. Fight off the robbers threatening the city and try the different characters as you work through their attacks.

pages.title: Riders Downhill Racing
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Take bikes and other rides down the hills in Riders Downhill Racing. Explore in Free Ride, compete in Race, or play Career, alone or with a second player.

pages.title: Freddys Nightmares Return Horror New Year
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Search a snow-covered city for an exit in Freddys Nightmares Return Horror New Year. Learn the streets in Escape mode and look for a way out while Freddy is nearby.

pages.title: Cooking Chef Food Fever
pages.creator: Rendered Ideas
pages.description: Serve orders before customers run out of patience in Cooking Chef Food Fever. Check what each customer wants and get the food out while you build up the kitchen.

pages.title: Train Bandit
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Move between wagons in Train Bandit. Hold to run, swipe up to jump, and use the revolver when the sheriffs fire. Pick up treasure as you work along the train.

pages.title: Candy Mahjong
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Look for matching sweets in Candy Mahjong. Clear pairs that are available and check which tiles become free as you work through the candy-themed layouts.

pages.title: Memory Match - Puzzle
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Turn over colorful cards in Memory Match - Puzzle. Remember what appeared in each spot and clear the board by finding identical pairs across the difficulty levels.

pages.title: Realistic City Parking
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Park in city traffic in Realistic City Parking. Use the arrows to drive and space to brake. Work through ten layouts and try to finish each one quickly.

pages.title: Make Eclairs Pastry
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Make chocolate pastries in Make Eclairs Pastry. Use the mouse to follow the recipe steps and work on the éclairs as the game shows you what to prepare next.

pages.title: Sponge Decor 3D
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Apply designs with a sponge in Sponge Decor 3D. Use the tools on each customer, earn money for your work, and unlock different sponge effects.

pages.title: Snowball Racing
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Gather snow as you race in Snowball Racing. Swerve to build a larger ball and use its size to bump other racers before reaching the end.

pages.title: Slope Ball
pages.creator: Greenlight
pages.description: Jump past deadly obstacles in Slope Ball. Guide the ball through a world damaged by five giant creatures and keep it moving as you work to save the planet.

pages.title: Egg Wars
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Fight from a first-person view in Egg Wars. Choose Team PvP or Battle Royale, and remember to reload as you move through the fight and try to survive.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Candy 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Aim a shot into matching sweets in Bubble Shooter Candy 2. Clear groups of the same color and try to open up the cluster for a higher-scoring shot.

pages.title: Tom Memory
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Study the pictures before the cards turn over in Tom Memory. Find identical pairs from memory and get ready for more cards as the levels progress.

pages.title: Noob Ninja Guardian
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Defend the dojo in Noob Ninja Guardian. Aim the guardian toward incoming enemies and keep them from getting past you, then spend coins to improve skills.

pages.title: Unlocking
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Work out how to open each lock in Unlocking. Examine how the pieces fit and make changes that release the mechanism without having to break the door.

pages.title: Kill the Dummy
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Slice the dummies in Kill the Dummy and avoid the bombs. Keep moving the saw through safe targets as you try to build a higher score in Classic mode.

pages.title: POP it Plus
pages.creator: MURAT KYABISHEV
pages.description: Pop the toy's bubbles to score in POP it Plus. Later, watch for balls among the bubbles and select the corresponding large ball when you need to collect one.

pages.title: Pandemic Fashion Mask
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Build an outfit around a face mask in Pandemic Fashion Mask. Try clothes and accessories from head to toe and pick a mask that suits the finished look.

pages.title: Stars Numbers
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Use the stars to practice counting in Stars Numbers. Look at the number shown and work out the matching quantity as you move through the activity.

pages.title: SpaceUgh!
pages.creator: TastyAir s.r.o.
pages.description: Pick up and transport astronauts in SpaceUgh! Pilot a craft between points on each planet and get the passengers where they need to go.

pages.title: Light Speed Superhero Rescue Mission
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Take on rescue missions in Light Speed Superhero Rescue Mission. Move through the city as a fast superhero and face enemy forces as the assignments unfold.

pages.title: City Taxi Simulator 3d
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Pick up and drop off riders in City Taxi Simulator 3d. Park in the right direction at each stop and keep an eye on the time as you drive.

pages.title: Impossible Track Car Drive Challenge
pages.creator: gameworld
pages.description: Steer a car along elevated courses in Impossible Track Car Drive Challenge. Stay on the route around turns and leave yourself room to line up for the next stretch.

pages.title: Happy Animals Jigsaw Game
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Fit animal pictures together in Happy Animals Jigsaw Game. Choose a layout from four to twenty-four pieces, then use the mouse to join the shapes.

pages.title: Coach Bus Simulator 2020
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Drive a coach through an open city in Coach Bus Simulator 2020. Watch the other traffic and work through routes while handling the bus from its interior view.

pages.title: Anti Virus Game
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Drag your ship around the screen in Anti Virus Game to shoot the incoming viruses. Upgrade the ship and weapons as the next levels bring stronger targets.

pages.title: Bus Mountain Drive
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Take a bus over hill roads in Bus Mountain Drive. Use the arrow keys and space to control the vehicle and judge your approach as the route climbs.

pages.title: BMW S1000RR Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Slide pieces of a BMW motorcycle picture in BMW S1000RR Slide. Pick one of three images and use details from the frame and wheels to restore the scene.

pages.title: Beware The Bridges
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Line up bridge sections in Beware The Bridges to keep the crossing going. Use the mouse to make each connection and see how long you can keep scoring.

pages.title: Amsterdam Car Parking
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Steer into parking spots around Amsterdam in Amsterdam Car Parking. Use WASD or the arrows and give yourself space to line up the car before pulling into each spot.

pages.title: Dragon Simulator
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Fly a dragon against others in Dragon Simulator. Climb with space and use fireballs, flame breath, or a close attack depending on where the enemy is.

pages.title: Space Jump
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Move a spaceship past obstacles in Space Jump. Click to change its movement as each gap approaches and see how many barriers you can get past.

pages.title: Beach Dress Up
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Choose a look for the princess in Beach Dress Up. Use the mouse to try the outfits and decide which combination suits her sunny day at the beach.

pages.title: monster truck driving simulator game
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Take a big truck over stunt jumps in monster truck driving simulator game. Build up speed for a ramp and see what you can smash through along the way.

pages.title: Christmas Presents Memory
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Turn over cards to match gifts in Christmas Presents Memory. Use the mouse or touchscreen and try to clear each of the four layouts with fewer moves.

pages.title: Knife Ninja
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Throw every blade into the target in Knife Ninja. Time your shots as it moves, and aim for apples when a clear throw can give you extra points.

pages.title: Mars Landing
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Guide a UFO onto landing platforms in Mars Landing. Use WASD or the arrows and control the approach carefully across fifteen levels.

pages.title: Dont Touch The Spikes
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Keep a little bird away from spikes in Dont Touch The Spikes. Use the mouse to control its flight and look for room to move before the next hazard.

pages.title: Spin Soccer
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Rotate the course in Spin Soccer to roll the ball into the net. Use the left and right controls and keep the ball away from the spikes on the way.

pages.title: Fast Food Match 3
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Make matches of three or more food items in Fast Food Match 3. Keep finding groups to build a score before the meter at the left runs down.

pages.title: Zombie Live
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Eat brains and dodge falling bombs in Zombie Live. Click to move the green zombie, and choose a route that keeps it alive while you raise the score.

pages.title: Banana Poker
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Read the behavior of different opponents in Banana Poker. Watch how each character plays and adjust your decisions as you work through hands against the lineup.

pages.title: Impossible Bike Race: Racing Games 3D 2019
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Ride across challenging stunt courses in Impossible Bike Race: Racing Games 3D 2019. Time your jumps and keep the bike stable as you try to finish each track.

pages.title: Mahjong Connect Halloween
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Find identical spooky symbols in Mahjong Connect Halloween. Look for a route that connects a pair and clear tiles in an order that opens up the remaining ones.

pages.title: Super Hero Family Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Put a dozen superhero family scenes together in Super Hero Family Jigsaw. Choose Easy, Normal, or Hard and restore each cartoon by matching its pieces.

pages.title: Arnie Attack
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Collect diamonds and fight through the jungle in Arnie Attack. Move with the arrows and fire with space. Clear the enemies and finish each level before time runs out.

pages.title: Sniper Mission 3D
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Complete assignments in Sniper Mission 3D. Use the mouse wheel to zoom, line up the target, and fire with the left button. Improve your weapons as you advance.

pages.title: Elite Archery
pages.creator: Dumadu Games Pvt Ltd
pages.description: Draw a bow and aim across the range in Elite Archery. Watch the power bar when setting up a shot and use the modes to practice your accuracy.

pages.title: Hangman
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Guess letters to reveal hidden words in Hangman. Correct answers earn points and diamonds, and you can spend diamonds on a hint when you're stuck.

pages.title: Ice Cream Making
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Make ice cream in Ice Cream Making. Pick a flavor and try different toppings, then see how your choices look together before making another serving.

pages.title: Mini Sports Cars Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble pictures of small sports cars in Mini Sports Cars Puzzle. Pick from six images and four piece counts, using the bodywork to help fit neighboring pieces.

pages.title: Car Take Off
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Guide a car through the driving challenge in Car Take Off. Use the mouse or arrow keys to steer and watch the route ahead to prepare for the next turn.

pages.title: Color Cellz
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Place colored pieces along paths in Color Cellz. Turn the path as needed and connect at least four cells of one color to clear them.

pages.title: Arty Mouse Learn ABC
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Trace letters from A to Z in Arty Mouse Learn ABC. Follow the shapes with familiar characters and listen to the sounds connected to each letter.

pages.title: Currency Symbols
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Pair matching symbols in Currency Symbols before the timer expires. Keep track of the cards you turn over as you work through four increasingly difficult layouts.

pages.title: Pixel Farm
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Grow vegetables in Pixel Farm. Plant crops, collect them when ready, and repeat the process as you work through three levels on the farm.

pages.title: Old Timer Car Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Rebuild pictures of classic cars in Old Timer Car Jigsaw. Pick one of twelve images and solve it with 25, 49, or 100 pieces.

pages.title: Mountain Vacantion
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Choose clothes for the mountains in Mountain Vacantion. Try different winter outfits and accessories on the princesses and create a look for each one.

pages.title: Military Defense Strike
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Fire a heavy machine gun at attackers in Military Defense Strike. Watch the approach to the castle and aim before enemies can get close to the base.

pages.title: Classic Hangman
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Work out a hidden word letter by letter in Classic Hangman. Use the letters you've uncovered to narrow your choices and try to finish before the drawing is complete.

pages.title: Heros Journey
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Click to attack monsters in Heros Journey. Earn gold from successful hits and spend it on power-ups such as healing before you face the boss.

pages.title: Masked Forces Zombie Survival
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Hold off stronger waves in Masked Forces Zombie Survival. Choose weapons that let you deal with the next group of zombies and keep an eye on the approaching enemies.

pages.title: Battleship War Multiplayer
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Fire missiles at squares in Battleship War Multiplayer. Use hits to work out where ships are positioned and spend earned points on power-ups as you hunt the fleet.

pages.title: Superhero or Cute Girl
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Style two sides of a princess in Superhero or Cute Girl. Make a hero costume and an everyday look, then compare what each outfit brings out.

pages.title: Knife Shooter
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Time knife throws in Knife Shooter. Watch where the target moves, wait until it lines up, and launch the blade to keep your scoring attempt going.

pages.title: Acorns Park
pages.creator: Un Mirlo en la Nieve
pages.description: Use carefully aimed shots to drive off the squirrels in Acorns Park. Pick out the gang members and watch for the police as you try to clear the park.

pages.title: Fidget Spinna
pages.creator: Freeplaynow
pages.description: Build and spin a toy in Fidget Spinna. Collect money from spinning and use it to improve the parts, then see how the upgraded spinner performs.

pages.title: Princesses College Day
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Choose party clothes in Princesses College Day. Try different dresses for the princesses and put together a look for each of them before the weekend event.

pages.title: Hexagone
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Link matching fruit in Hexagone. Build groups of at least three and look for longer paths through the hex tiles to raise your score.

pages.title: Girly Ice Cream Truck Car Wash
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Restore an ice cream truck in Girly Ice Cream Truck Car Wash. Follow the workshop steps to repair the vehicle and clean it up so it looks ready for service.

pages.title: Princess Superstar Cover Magazine
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare Belle for a cover shoot in Princess Superstar Cover Magazine. Try makeup and dresses and choose the combination you want the photographer to capture.
